messages:
maria: Hey all — planning a short cross-team push to add a standard set of GPU pool metrics for Hosted + Dedicated. Need alignment on names, labels, sampling, and dashboard UX. Proposed core metrics: SM_occupancy, sm_memory_bytes, queue_depth, req_latency_p50_p95_p99. Who wants to own ingestion + schema?
aj: Quick q — how do we want to treat Dedicated vs Hosted? Same metric names with a label `pool_type` or separate metrics? :thinking_face:
devon: I'd vote same metric with `pool_type` label. But watch label cardinality: avoid tenant_id on high-cardinality time series. Keep per-pool_id and pool_type. Sampling: 10s emit, 1m rollup for dashboards.
lucas: +1 on labels but we should call the occupancy metric `gpu_sm_occupancy_ratio` (0..1) to avoid confusion vs absolute SM counts. Also add `gpu_memory_used_bytes` and `gpu_memory_total_bytes` so we can compute fragmentation.
sre-bot: ALERT RULE SUGGESTION: queue_depth > 100 for 5m in Dedicated pools => paging. Posting to #eng-oncall.
ops-jen: For quotas: we need queue_depth + per-tenant token consumption to enforce soft quota. Are we okay with emitting tenant_id as a metric label? security asked no PII in high-cardinality metrics.
maria: ops-jen: agree — don't emit tenant_id in metrics. Use tenant hash in traces only. For quotas, the API will call the quota service which will join metrics via pool_id and request metadata.
devon: Implementation note — runtime can emit these via the existing metrics client. Quick proto: ```
message GpuPoolSample {
  string pool_id = 1;
  string pool_type = 2; // "hosted" | "dedicated"
  double gpu_sm_occupancy = 3; // 0..1
  uint64 gpu_memory_used_bytes = 4;
  uint64 gpu_memory_total_bytes = 5;
  uint32 queue_depth = 6;
  map<string, double> latency_pxx = 7; // keys: p50,p95,p99
}
``` Please review naming.
aj: small nit — map in proto can be messy for our exporter. Maybe explicit `p50_ms`, `p95_ms`, `p99_ms` fields.
lucas: Also add `instance_type` label (e.g., a100-40g, 3090) for cost dashboards.
maria: Rollout plan: 1) emit v0 metrics with `gpu_..._v0` prefix for 2 weeks, dashboards in Console team pick v0. 2) After feedback, flip to stable names and deprecate v0. We'll canary by deploying to a subset of Hosted pools and one Dedicated tenant. 3) Provide runbook + alerts. Can we get owners: ingestion: devex-infra (devon), dashboard: console (aj), alerts/runbook: eng-sre (lucas), quota integration: ops (ops-jen).
ops-jen: ack, will carve out work to wire quota service to read the new metrics. We'll avoid tenant_id in metrics; will correlate at request time.
devon: I'll open the metrics PR and include both proto and exporter changes. Also will emit a short-lived wire format `gpu_metrics_v0` topic in telemetry for two weeks.
aj: I'll start a Console PR to add panels: occupancy heatmap, memory headroom, queue depth timeseries, and a per-pool table with p95 latency. UX note: show Hosted/Dedicated toggle and allow filtering by instance_type.
maria: Great. Can we sync tomorrow 10am? If so I'll post an RFC with the exact field names and example Grafana queries. :thumbsup: \nlucas: :eyes: please add suggested alert thresholds to the RFC (queue_depth, memory headroom %) and include cost per-instance_type calc.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry-exporter v3 deployed to canary-hosted-1 at 2100001255
maria: thanks — assigned action items in the RFC. Meeting scheduled. :white_check_mark:
